title.zh: 将布拉干省Baliuag市镇Sulivan中学延伸校从Mariano Ponce中学分离，改设为独立的国立中学，名称为Sulivan国立中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing For the Separation of the Sulivan High School Extension in the Municipality of Baliuag, Province of Bulacan, From the Mariano Ponce High School, and Converting the Same Into An Independent National High School To Be Known As the Sulivan National High School, and Providing Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing For the Separation of the Sulivan High School Extension in the Municipality of Baliuag, Province of Bulacan, From the Mariano Ponce High School, and Converting the Same Into An Independent National High School To Be Known As the Sulivan National High School, and Providing Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1997/ra_8305_1997.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Sulivan High School extension in Barangay Sulivan, Municipality of Baliuag, Province of Bulacan, is hereby separated from the Mariano Ponce High School, also in the Municipality of Baliuag, and converted into an independent national high school, to be known as the Sulivan National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Mariano Ponce National High School – Sulivan High School Extension. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the Sulivan National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
